candidateFindings.title: Task incomplete marker overrides controller status and unreadable-control fallback
candidateFindings.claim: For a terminal direct-dynamic run containing a task marked dynamic_incomplete, summarizeWorkflowTerminal selects dynamic_incomplete even when reading control.json rejects. This bypasses the explicitly required completed_without_semantic_result fallback. The same branch also overrides readable controller status.
specEvidence: SPEC.md:49-51 requires terminal direct-dynamic semantic status to derive from controller control.json and says an unreadable control yields completed_without_semantic_result.
implementationEvidence: src/workflow-terminal.ts:59-61 converts a rejected control.json read into undefined.
src/workflow-terminal.ts:80-86 selects dynamic_incomplete from run.tasks before examining control.status.
src/workflow-terminal.ts:87-95 reaches controller-derived statuses and completed_without_semantic_result only when no incomplete task was found.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: This is an unexecuted static counterexample; the sample excludes run types and store helpers. An independent verifier should seek repository evidence that excludes terminal direct-dynamic runs with an incomplete task and unreadable control, or establishes an allowed precedence exception, rather than merely confirming the branch wording.

needsHuman.reason: SPEC item 12 requires completed_degraded for completed runs with degradation, while item 13 assigns controller-derived semantics to terminal direct-dynamic runs. Source implements the degradation baseline but overrides it for direct-dynamic runs; precedence between these requirements is not explicit.
needsHuman.uncertainty: Item 13 may be an intended specialization of item 12. No separate violation is asserted for this overlap.
needsHuman.recommendedAction: Clarify whether terminal direct-dynamic semantics override completed_degraded, or establish that degraded completed runs cannot enter that branch.
